auth.title: Sign in to ERP POS

pos.title: New Sale

pos.customer_clear: Sell to a walk-in customer instead

pos.complete_hint: Add a product to take payment.

cashier.title: Cashier shifts
cashier.subtitle: Open a shift before you start selling, and count the drawer when you finish.
cashier.open_help: Each cashier can have one open shift per cash drawer.
cashier.opening_float_help: Count the cash in the drawer before the first sale.
cashier.open_missing: Choose a warehouse and a cash drawer account first.
cashier.open_float_invalid: Enter the opening cash as an amount of zero or more.
cashier.opened: Shift opened. You are ready to sell.
cashier.load_failed: We couldn't load the shifts. Check your connection, then try again.
cashier.empty: No shifts yet. Open your first shift above to start selling.
cashier.counted_label: Cash counted in the drawer for {name} (৳)
cashier.close_missing: Count the cash in the drawer and enter the amount first.
cashier.close_body: You counted {amount} in the drawer. After closing, no more sales can be added to this shift.
cashier.closed_short: Shift closed. The drawer is short by {amount} — tell your supervisor.
cashier.closed_over: Shift closed. The drawer is over by {amount} — tell your supervisor.

sales.title: Sales History
sales.subtitle: Find a sale to see its items and payments, print it again, or take a return.
sales.filter_search_placeholder: e.g. SALE-000123 or a customer name
sales.load_failed: We couldn't load the sales. Check your connection, then try again.
sales.empty: No sales yet. Make your first sale and it will show up here.
sales.empty_filtered: No sales match these filters. Change the dates or clear the filters.
sales.void_body: This takes {amount} off the books: the stock goes back to the warehouse, and the payments and accounting entries are reversed. It cannot be undone.
sales.void_reason: Why is this sale being cancelled?
sales.void_reason_help: The reason is saved in the activity history.
sales.void_reason_required: Write a short reason before cancelling the sale.
sales.voided: Sale {ref} is cancelled. Stock and payments were reversed.
payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Money received and paid outside a sale: customer advances, refunds, and payments to suppliers. Each saved payment is added to the accounts.
payments.dialog_help: Use this for money that is not part of a sale. Payments for a sale are recorded on the New Sale screen.
payments.account_placeholder: Choose where the money goes or comes from
payments.notes_placeholder: Anything worth remembering about this payment
payments.options_failed: We couldn't load the branches and accounts. Close this window and open it again to retry.
payments.err_branch: Choose the branch this payment belongs to.
payments.err_generic: the server did not accept it. Check the details and try again
payments.err_network: We couldn't reach the server, so the payment may not be saved. Refresh the list before you try again.
payments.supplier_help: Choose who received the money. Without one, a manager must approve the payment.
payments.approval_needed: A manager needs to approve paying out {amount} with no supplier.
payments.approval_ask_manager: Ask a manager to request and approve it, or choose the supplier.
payments.approval_requested: Approval requested. When a manager approves it under Approvals, save again.
payments.approval_waiting: Not approved yet. Ask the manager to check Approvals, then save again.
payments.load_failed: We couldn't load the payments. Check your connection, then try again.
payments.empty: No payments yet. Record a payment and it will show up here.
payments.empty_filtered: No payments have this status. Choose another status to see more.
inventory.title: Stock & Inventory
inventory.subtitle: See how much of each product is in every warehouse, what is reserved, and what it is worth.
inventory.list_help: On hand is what is physically there. Available is what you can still sell after reservations.
inventory.search_placeholder: Search by product name, code or warehouse
inventory.load_failed: We couldn't load the stock list. Check your connection, then try again.
inventory.empty: No stock yet. Add your opening stock to start tracking a warehouse.
inventory.empty_low: Nothing is running low. Every product is above its reorder level.
inventory.empty_search: No stock matches “{query}”. Check the spelling or clear the search.
inventory.movements_body: A line-by-line history of stock movements is not available yet. The quantities and values above are up to date.
pos.line_discount_help: Taka off this whole line, not each unit.
pos.line_discount_too_big: The discount is more than this line costs.
pos.timing_full_help: The whole total is paid now.
pos.timing_part_help: Some is paid now; the rest is owed on the dates you set below. Needs a registered customer.
pos.timing_later_help: Nothing is paid now; the whole total is owed on the dates you set below. Needs a registered customer.
pos.amount_part_help: Less than the total. The rest becomes the customer’s due.
pos.schedule_due_date: Due date for the whole balance
pos.schedule_months_help: Same day each month. When a month is shorter (31st in February), it falls on that month’s last day, then returns to the 31st.
pos.schedule_days_help: A fixed number of days apart, so “every 30 days” drifts against calendar months. The server splits the amount; any paisa left over goes on the last installment.
pos.schedule_fill_last: Put the difference on the last row
pos.schedule_reminders: Send SMS reminders before each due date
pos.revised_body: The total is now {to} (was {from}). Check with the customer, then complete the sale at the new total.
pos.err.credit_customer: Choose a registered customer to leave money owing.
pos.err.part_amount: Enter an amount paid now that is more than zero and less than the total.
pos.err.custom_rows: Each installment needs a date and an amount.
pos.add_customer_help: Only the name is required. The sale you are making stays exactly as it is.
pos.add_customer_name_long: Use 200 characters or fewer for the name.
pos.add_customer_phone_help: Optional. Use up to 30 characters, as on the customer record. Mobile validity for SMS is checked separately.
pos.add_customer_phone_invalid: Not a valid Bangladeshi mobile number (01XXXXXXXXX). Fix it or leave it empty.
pos.add_customer_credit_help: The most this customer may owe. A new customer with no limit cannot buy on credit.
pos.add_customer_matches: Already a customer? Pick them instead of adding again.
pos.add_customer_forbidden: You do not have permission to add customers. Ask a manager, or sell to a walk-in customer if the sale is paid in full.
pos.add_customer_failed: We couldn’t save the customer: {reason}. Your details are kept; fix them and try again.
pos.add_customer_network: The connection dropped, so we don’t know if the customer was saved. Try again: it will not be saved twice.
pos.add_customer_phone_long: Use 30 characters or fewer for the phone number.
pos.add_customer_search_failed: We could not check for existing customers. Retry the search before saving.
pos.add_customer_search_forbidden: You cannot search customer records. Ask a manager to check for an existing customer before creating one.
pos.add_customer_separate_help: Names and phone numbers are not unique. Pick the correct record, or explicitly save a separate customer. No records will be merged.
pos.customer_search_label: Search customers by name or mobile
pos.customer_no_results: No customers match this name or mobile.

coupons.description: Codes customers give at the till for money off a sale. One coupon per sale.

offline.setup_title: Keep selling if the internet drops
offline.setup_body: Set this browser up as a till. It keeps the product list, takes cash sales while offline, and sends them when the connection is back.
offline.setup_hint: Offline sales use the warehouse above and the cash account chosen under Payment.
offline.setup_missing: First choose the warehouse above and a cash drawer as the payment account.
offline.setup_done: This till is ready for offline cash sales.
offline.setup_failed: We couldn't set up this till — {reason}
offline.panel_products: {count} products saved for offline sales, updated {when}.
offline.panel_no_products: No product list saved yet. Update it while online.
offline.panel_queued: {count, plural, one {# offline sale is} other {# offline sales are}} waiting to be sent.
offline.panel_nothing_queued: All offline sales have been sent.
offline.refresh_failed: We couldn't update the product list — {reason}
offline.sent: {count, plural, one {# offline sale} other {# offline sales}} saved to the books.
offline.refused: {count, plural, one {# offline sale needs} other {# offline sales need}} a manager — see the till panel.
offline.send_stopped: Sending paused: the server could not be reached. The sales are safe on this till and will be sent again.
offline.attention_title: {count, plural, one {# sale needs} other {# sales need}} a manager
offline.attention_body: The cash for these was taken, so they stay on this till. Fix the reason shown (for example, stock), then send again.
offline.offline_body: Cash sales only. They're saved on this till and sent automatically when the internet is back.
offline.not_set_up: This browser is not set up as a till, so it cannot take sales offline. Reconnect to keep selling.
offline.expired: The saved prices are too old to sell with. Reconnect to update the product list.
offline.queued_done: Offline sale {n} saved on this till — {amount} in cash.
offline.cart_empty: Search above to add a product.
offline.max_qty: Offline, a line can hold up to {max}.
offline.cash_only: Paid in full, in cash. Card, mobile wallet, credit, gift cards and points need a connection.
offline.change_hint: Enter the cash you were handed to see the change.
offline.save_failed: We couldn't save the sale on this till — {reason}
pos.paid_in_full_note: Paid in full: {amount}. To take it two ways, add a split payment.

tills.title: Tills
tills.description: Browsers set up to take cash sales offline. Revoke a till that is lost, stolen or no longer used.
tills.empty: No tills yet. A manager sets one up from New Sale.
tills.confirm_effect: It will no longer download the product list or send offline sales. Sales it has already sent stay posted.
tills.confirm_pending: Any offline sales still waiting on that till cannot be sent after this. If you have the till, open New Sale on it and send them first.
tills.confirm_sessions: This does not sign anyone out. To stop a person, deactivate their user as well.
tills.confirm_final: Revoking cannot be undone; set the browser up again to use it as a till.
tills.reason_hint: Kept in the audit log, for example "Laptop stolen from Dhanmondi counter".
pos.points_consent_help: The customer confirms with a code sent to their phone. Choosing the customer isn't enough.
pos.points_code_wrong: That code is not right. {left} tries left.
pos.err.points_confirm: The customer must confirm the points with the code sent to their phone.
offline.others_title: {count, plural, one {# sale} other {# sales}} taken by another cashier
offline.others_body: Only the cashier who took a sale can send it, so it is credited to the right person. Ask them to sign in on this till.
offline.adopt_reason: Reason (only if that cashier can't sign in any more)
offline.posted_by_manager: Offline sale {n} posted under your name. The audit log keeps who took it.
offline.no_cashier: Sign in while online before taking offline sales.
